lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: The transcript mentions a receipt for gasoline, but the scan in the office drive is totally cut off.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: It's completely useless like this.

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: Hey! I just came from the Admin building.

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: Mr. Reyes is inspecting the campus grounds with the C.A.T. officers!

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: But listen... Enzo sent a frantic text right before his phone died.

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: He said he dropped the physical receipt while running away from the administration office earlier!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Where?!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Did he say where?

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: He just typed 'Bleachers... basketball court... left it near—' and then his phone went offline!

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: The C.A.T. drill just ended out there, so the area is crawling with cadets.

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: If the guard or a school officer finds it first, we lose our only proof!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I'm on it.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I'll act casual, blend into the crowd, and search the bleachers.

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: Did you check the bleachers near the basketball court yet?

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: Search carefully!

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: Enzo said he dropped the physical receipt somewhere around there.

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: Awesome!

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: You managed to get the physical receipt back from Jules!

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: Show it to Mrs. Santos right away so we can finalize the evidence board.

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: Enzo's phone went offline right after he texted us about the receipt!

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: We need to find that physical copy before school officers clean up the bleachers.
